candidates.name: Index polygons spatial data (INSPIRE) download
verified_facts: The July 2026 INSPIRE Index Polygons release is downloadable by local authority
The dataset represents indicative position and extent of registered freehold properties and is refreshed monthly
Files are supplied for GIS use as HMLR INSPIRE polygon data
semantic_limits: The polygon is indicative and does not establish the legal extent of a registered title
A committed INSPIRE ID remains a seed until the F-host freshly downloads GML and verifies exact ID plus point-in-polygon

candidates.name: Technical guidance for GML files
verified_facts: HMLR supplies the dataset in GML as an open format compliant with the INSPIRE framework
GIS consumers must use an appropriate projection when converting or integrating GML
semantic_limits: Format guidance does not validate a parcel match; exact identifier and geometry checks remain mandatory

candidates.name: LiDAR Composite DTM 1m Web Coverage Service
verified_facts: The non-year-specific LiDAR Composite DTM 1m WCS endpoint is the persistent Environment Agency service form
The official service supports WCS 2.0.1 GetCapabilities and coverage retrieval
semantic_limits: A reachable service is not a numeric result; the F-host must hash the returned TIFF and sample only valid pixel centres inside the exact HMLR polygon

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 Open Data download
verified_facts: OS Terrain 50 covers all Great Britain and is available as free OpenData
The official product page reports a July 2026 version and supplies grid/vector formats
semantic_limits: Terrain 50 is a secondary crosscheck and cannot replace the Environment Agency DTM 1m primary polygon sample
